html:
Huge hack if you're using Grok Bot:

Cursor has much fewer connectors than Claude/ChatGPT but the way to get around that is by using Composio.

-Connect Composio connector to Grok Bot
-Connect to any of Composio's 1,000+ integrations
-Your bot can now use those tools via Composio…

— Corey Ganim (@coreyganim) August 26, 2026
